canonical_data: service-managed team documents, connected-source indexes, answer citations, verification state, and drafted knowledge updates
current_repo_note: Slite Agent is represented as a core capability of the Slite knowledge product rather than as a separate autonomous-agent system.
strengths: Combines editable team documentation and connected sources with cited answers
Detects stale knowledge and drafts updates while keeping publication under human review
MCP, API, integrations, exports, and cross-source search provide useful access paths
weaknesses: Proprietary cloud service with service-managed indexing and retrieval internals
Export and retention capabilities vary by plan and do not reproduce the full operational system
Automated drift detection and drafted corrections still depend on human triage for trustworthy knowledge
why_it_matters: A strong reference for knowledge systems that use an agent to maintain human-owned organizational memory instead of replacing it with an opaque chat history.
